summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily purchases of its own ordinary shares under an ongoing share buyback programme announced on 12 March 2026. Between 20-24 April 2026, the company purchased a total of 8,444,107 shares at volume-weighted average prices ranging from approximately 345.6 to 355.7 pence per share across multiple venues, all for cancellation. This is a routine capital return activity, not a special situation event.
